title: Credits
description: Abbey Road’s real credits roll up a black screen as a film end crawl: the four Beatles, Billy Preston, George Martin, Geoff Emerick and Phil McDonald, every song and its writer, set in a centred two-column Garamond with grain, halation and gate weave. Drag or scroll to scrub with weight, let go and it rolls on at its own pace to a quiet last card.
intent: One thing done like the real thing: a projected end-credits crawl you can grab, with capped inertia that always relaxes back to the film’s own pace, and a projector you can hear speed up under your hand.
